sources.title: Vision-language-action model - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: In robot learning, a vision-language-action model (VLA) is a class of multimodal foundation models that integrates vision, language and actions. Given an input image (or video) of the robot's surroundings and a text instruction, a VLA directly outputs low-level robot actions that can be executed to accomplish the requested task.
